correctness.rationale: Under Stam sample K with mass k^n/(e B_n k!), independent uniform K-box labels at vertices, equality constraints for forest edge subsets of size j have conditional probability K^-j because an acyclic edge subset has |V|−components=j. Thus conditional indicators are jointly independent Bernoulli(1/K) and X|K~Bin(e,1/K), including all forest shapes; cyclic graphs fail this factorization. Exact factorial moments (e)_j B_(n−j)/B_n and inclusion-exclusion follow by edge contraction. Consecutive k^n/k! weight ratios are monotonically decreasing; mode at t=n/W(n)+O(1), and moderate deviation |K−t|>n^(3/4)/W(n) is O(n exp(−c√n)), sufficiently small relative to min main probability exp(−W(n))=W(n)/n. Inside event K=t(1+O(n^-1/4)), uniform e<=n−1 yields |e/K−e W/n|=O(W n^-1/4), e/K²=O(W²/n); Le Cam and Poisson coupling give TV o(1), while e log(1−1/K)=−e W/n+o(1) gives relative avoidance. Independent exhaustive enumeration of set partitions n=3..6 and all path edge counts matched exact Bell-transform law, not used for limit proof.
